description: CAMELOT benchmark for Structural Health Monitoring is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors GAETANO MIRAGLIA, Marco Civera (Politecnico di Torino). This dataset contains the experimental data collected during testing campaigns conducted to validate CAMELOT (struCturAl ModEL cOrroboration Toolbox ). Developed by the Earthquake Engineering and Dynamics Laboratory (EEDLab) at Politecnico di Torino, CAMELOT is an advanced structural health monitoring platform designed to assess the integrity of buildings and infrastructures. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
